## BlobUploadMethod

Upload strategy negotiated by \`createBlobUploadInit\`.

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Graphql` | Upload via GraphQL mutation body (small blobs). |
| `Multipart` | Multipart upload via the \`/api/blob-upload/\` REST endpoints. |
| `Presigned` | Pre-signed URL upload directly to object storage. |

## BrandLogoKind

Identifies which logo slot a brand-asset upload/delete targets. The two slots are mirrored on the entity as \`logo\_large\_blob\` / \`logo\_small\_blob\`.

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Large` | Cover-page / hero logo. Maps to \`logo\_large\_blob\`. |
| `Small` | Header / footer mark. Maps to \`logo\_small\_blob\`. |

## ConflictResolution

Resolution strategy for a calendar conflict.

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `KeepLocal` | Overwrite the remote with our local version. |
| `KeepRemote` | Discard our local changes and use the remote version. |
| `MergeAuto` | Attempt an automatic three-way merge. |

## GitSyncAuthMethod

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `HttpsPassword` | Username + password over HTTPS. |

## GitSyncConflictKind

Kind of conflict detected during reconciliation. Maps to \[\`myoxus\_domain::git\_sync::ConflictType\`\].

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `BothModified` | Both Myoxus and Git modified the same document since last sync. |
| `DeleteVsModify` | Deleted in Git, modified in Myoxus. |
| `ModifyVsDelete` | Modified in Git, deleted in Myoxus. |
| `RenameVsModify` | One side renamed, the other modified. |
| `RenameVsRename` | Both sides renamed the document to different targets. |

## GitSyncConflictResolution

Resolution strategy for a Git Sync conflict. Maps to \[\`myoxus\_domain::git\_sync::ConflictResolution\`\] (without \`Open\`).

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Dismissed` | Conflict acknowledged but no action taken. |
| `GitWins` | Git version wins; Myoxus document overwritten. |
| `ManualMerge` | User provides manually merged content. |
| `MyoxusWins` | Myoxus version wins; Git file overwritten on next sync. |

## GitSyncDirection

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Bidirectional` | Both Myoxus-to-Git and Git-to-Myoxus. |
| `GitToMyoxus` | Import only: Git changes pulled into Myoxus. |
| `MyoxusToGit` | Export only: Myoxus changes pushed to Git. |

## GitSyncRunStatus

Lifecycle status of a sync run. Maps to \[\`myoxus\_domain::git\_sync::RunStatus\`\].

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Cancelled` | Run was cancelled before completion. |
| `Completed` | Run finished successfully. |
| `Failed` | Run terminated with an error. |
| `Pending` | Run is queued but not yet started. |
| `Running` | Run is currently executing. |

## GitSyncTriggerMode

How sync runs are triggered. Maps to \[\`myoxus\_domain::git\_sync::TriggerMode\`\].

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Cron` | Sync runs are admitted from server-calculated durable schedule slots. |
| `HistoryCapture` | Sync runs follow committed document-history captures. |
| `Manual` | Sync runs must be triggered explicitly via \`triggerGitSync\`. |
| `Polling` | Sync runs are triggered automatically at a configurable interval. |
| `Webhook` | Sync runs are triggered by a webhook from the Git provider (V2). |

## ServerDeploymentType

Identifies the server deployment model. This enum value is returned to clients via \`serverConfig.deploymentType\`. Clients branch on this value to control socket transport (polling+WS vs WS-only), telemetry transport (HTTP vs WebSocket), admin UI module visibility, sign-in flow guards and desktop invite dialogs. The GraphQL wire values deliberately use the same Myoxus vocabulary as the Rust model and operator configuration: \`Cloud\` / \`Standalone\`.

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Cloud` | Managed cloud deployment (Myoxus SaaS). Client effects: WS-only transport, WS telemetry, cloud UI modules. |
| `Standalone` | Standalone on-premise deployment. Client effects: polling+WS transport, HTTP telemetry, standalone UI. |

## ServerFeature

Optional server capabilities advertised to clients.

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Captcha` | CAPTCHA challenge is enabled on auth endpoints. |
| `Comment` | Document commenting is enabled (always true in Myoxus). |
| `Copilot` | Copilot AI integration is enabled. |
| `CopilotEmbedding` | Copilot embedding store is available (pgvector). |
| `Indexer` | Full-text search indexer is active (Postgres FTS + pgvector). |
| `LocalWorkspace` | Local-first Yjs workspaces are supported (always true in Myoxus). |
| `OAuth` | OAuth social login is configured. |
| `Payment` | Payment/billing is enabled (always \`false\` in Myoxus). |
